comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The mobile Google SERP leaves a broken AI Overview panel (only the sparkle icon and the "Не удалось сгенерировать обзор…" error) because the filter blocks its async/folsrch request; an unfiltered control renders the real overview. Adding google.com#⁠#⁠div[⁠data-async-type="folsrch"]⁠ to the existing "! Google Search - AI Overview" block in AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt verified clean (panel hidden, page intact), covering the page the older :⁠has() wrapper rule at line 354 no longer hides. ## Rule `google.com##div[data-async-type="folsrch"]` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale No closing rule in the run instruction applies:⁠ this is not a paywall, not a self-promotion banner, not an anti-adblock wall and not a scam page — it is an empty/broken leftover of a module the filter already blocks on purpose. It is a missed leftover on a fully reachable page, so it gets a rule; the AdGuard Other Annoyances purpose (irritating in-page elements) covers the broken AI Overview shell, and google.com has ample traffic. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c8892e39d7c9aab33d8841e45827df5c4a7dc7ce/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt) Under the heading `! SECTION: Other annoyances - Uncategorized`, before [line 357](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c8892e39d7c9aab33d8841e45827df5c4a7dc7ce/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/annoyances.txt#L357). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45518836641 Automated analysis against filters at `c8892e3`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"79fa9835e8fbb3c5146a12b49833c0b99b10124fdc60c1a956331a9540940610"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — The reported in-player Hulu ad could not be reproduced:⁠ the reported watch URL 301-redirects to the unsigned-in Castle series page, and complete full-page vision of that page (reporterSymptomPresence absent, 0 instances) shows no player, ad, placeholder or gap. The repository's existing "Hulu video ads" rules (BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt 22787-22794, replace.txt line 10) were active, so no new rule is warranted; a maintainer with a Hulu subscription should verify the player case before closing.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

The AdguardFilters run instruction states no rule that closes this report:⁠ it is an ads report (T:⁠ Ads, P1:⁠ Critical) and none of the instruction's closing categories (paywall, unreachable anti-adblock detector without a captured detector script, scam page) is established by the evidence. Policy lookup (KnowledgeBase filter-policy.md + CONTRIBUTING.md) returned no criterion that refuses an ad-blocking rule for a streaming player, so rule generation is allowed and the decision rests on reproduction.

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"608d5e137406474acfc77c066c18d23eadb352f2672c99b230ad6ef797695c48"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Live A/B/C experiments show filtering does break bypass.city's AceCaptcha (rings draw with no rules applied, blank challenge body with the reporter's baseline), and AdGuard CLI's shared Base filter XHR/denyallow rule blocks hc.acecaptcha.com, but a site-scoped allowlist exception - and even unfiltering the captcha's frames - left the challenge blank while the page showed its own "a content blocker may be stopping it" notice. No rule could be validated, so the report needs a maintainer's judgement on the site's ad/blocker gate.

## Still visible after the rule

- Centered AceCaptcha panel near top-middle of page, challenge body below the header/instruction line (approx. x=780–1135, y=218–465) — AceCaptcha verification panel heading and instruction text render, but the challenge body beneath is a completely empty dark rectangle with no ring targets, challenge graphics, or loading indicator — the interactive CAPTCHA content is missing.
- Centered AceCaptcha panel near top-middle of page, challenge body below the header/instruction line (approx. x=788–1145, y=218–465) — Same AceCaptcha panel with heading and instruction rendered while the challenge area stays a blank dark rectangle; no ring targets or challenge content are drawn, so verification cannot be completed.
- Centered AceCaptcha panel near top-middle of page, challenge body below the header/instruction line (approx. x=780–1135, y=221–466) — AceCaptcha panel again shows only its header and instruction with an empty dark challenge body; the ring-target challenge is absent, matching the reporter's missing-CAPTCHA-content symptom.
- AceCaptcha panel centered in the upper-middle of the page, roughly x=775-1135, y=210-465 within the tile; blank challenge area below the heading and instruction lines — The AceCaptcha widget's header ('Hold the ring with a gap', 'Follow it if it moves. Let go when it's full.', 'AceCaptcha' label) renders, but the region where the ring/hold challenge should be drawn is a large empty dark rectangle with no ring targets, ring outline, cursor target, or any CAPTCHA content at all. The interactive challenge content is missing, so the verification cannot be performed.
- Center of viewport:⁠ AceCaptcha panel headed 'Hold the ring with a gap' (approx. x=780–1142, y=210–470) — The AceCaptcha panel heading, instruction text, and 'AceCaptcha' label render, but the challenge area below is a blank dark rectangle with no ring targets or other interactive CAPTCHA content. This matches the reporter-described missing CAPTCHA content.

## Missing information

- No way to isolate the breaking filter/scriptlet in the adguard_cli proxy environment: In the locked adguard_cli environment, launch_browser accepts extension "none" only and refuses settings ("A control session (extension \⁠"none\⁠") runs no blocker and takes no \⁠"settings\⁠""), so the documented list-halving / settings.slice isolation procedure cannot be run at all, and there is no unfiltered control session to diff against other than apply_rule phase A. Additionally, get_applied_rules explicitly does not report $csp, $permissions, $removeparam, $removeheader, $replace or extended-CSS (#⁠?#⁠) actions, and reports element hiding only for the frames the reader can address; the captcha widget renders inside cross-origin hc.acecaptcha.com frames that evaluate_js and the structure probe cannot read. The full per-phase console log and the captcha frame's DOM were therefore unavailable, so the specific rule that stops the AceCaptcha challenge from drawing on bypass.city could not be named.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reporter's breakage reproduces:⁠ the mine player is replaced by the site's own video.js error ("No available working or supported playlists" / "your internet provider censor us"), while the unfiltered page plays the film once the site's pre-init gate is dismissed. Two Base-filter rules together cause it — the trusted-replace-xhr-response "Timeout:⁠0" scriptlet (line 780) makes the site skip its pre-init gate, and the .player-pre-init-ads CSS hide (line 779) makes that gate's close control unusable; each scoped exception was validated and rejected because the film still would not play, so the two lines need changing together.

## Still visible after the rule

- Main content under 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone 2001', around the 'REPORT AN ISSUE' bar and above the TRAILER / DOWNLOAD / WATCH LATER / FAVOURITES button row — The movie playback area is absent. No video player, video frame, controls, countdown overlay, or other playback content appears in the region where the film should play; the page moves directly into the report-issue bar and action buttons.
- Main movie playback region, between the 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone 2001' heading and the TRAILER/DOWNLOAD/WATCH LATER/FAVOURITES buttons — No video player, video frame, playback controls, error message, or placeholder block is visible; the movie playback area is missing, leaving only the title, REPORT AN ISSUE bar, and action buttons.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

### Comment
> False positive: opositors.cat is listed as Phishing since 2026-11-21 (see https://reports.adguard.com/en/opositors.cat/report.html).
> 
> opositors.cat is a public information portal about civil-service exams (oposicions) in Catalonia, Spain. It lists official job calls from public administrations with links to the official sources. It does not ask for passwords or payment data and does not imitate any other site. It is hosted on Vercel; Google Safe Browsing and Yandex Safe Browsing do not list it.
> 
> With AdGuard DNS (Default server, set as Private DNS on Android), Chrome shows ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR because the domain resolves to the AdGuard block page.
> 
> Steps to reproduce: use AdGuard DNS Default server, open https://opositors.cat/

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — With the reporter's own selection (AdGuard Base filter) the u-tv.ru episode page loads and the player's seek bar is present and working — 742x24 timeline, progress fill and 00:⁠25 / 01:⁠14:⁠30 time labels after a tap — while the only rules acting are three AdGuard Base network blocks on ad/tracking requests (AdRiver, Yandex Metrika pixel, Yandex ad SDK) and no element-hiding rule or scriptlet. The missing controls in the reporter's screenshots are the player's own idle state, shown identically in their AdGuard-disabled capture, so the reported breakage did not reproduce and no rule is proposed.

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy states no rule that closes this report; it is an Incorrect Blocking report about a video player control on www⁠.u-tv.ru, so rule generation was open. I searched for a filtering mechanism to except or replace (blocked ad SDK, ad/tracking requests, hidden player elements, scriptlets) and found none, so the report says no rule is needed; the maintainer decides.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — about.me pins a third-party bot chat (\⁠"Chat with Ami, the About Me Virtual Twin guide\⁠") plus a launcher over the bottom-right corner via cdn.apigateway.co's webchat SDK; hiding the injected webchat iframe with about.me#⁠#⁠iframe[⁠data-webchat-frame]⁠ verified clean (symptom resolved, page intact). Place it in AnnoyancesFilter/Widgets/sections/widgets.txt at the end of \⁠"SECTION:⁠ Widgets - Chats (specific)\⁠" (before line 2271); the network alternative ||cdn.apigateway.co/webchat-client$domain=about.me is equally supported by the captured requests. ## Rule `about.me##iframe[data-webchat-frame]` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale No policy rule in the run instruction closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall (no detector request appears in the captured HAR), and it is not a scam/phishing page. The AdGuard Widgets filter policy covers chat widgets that are not integrated with the page content:⁠ this floating bot chat pinned over the bottom-right corner is such a widget, served by a third-party webchat platform (cdn.apigateway.co). A maintainer may instead judge the AI-twin assistant as the site's own self-promotion, in which case the same rule belongs in AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt — recorded as an alternative placement, not a blocker. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Widgets/sections/widgets.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6fc8adbd290488f19369697d482af6eb0462e9cf/AnnoyancesFilter/Widgets/sections/widgets.txt) Under the heading `! SECTION: Widgets - Chats (specific)`, before [line 2271](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/6fc8adbd290488f19369697d482af6eb0462e9cf/AnnoyancesFilter/Widgets/sections/widgets.txt#L2271). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version Helium built-in ad blocker ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? other (specify in comment below) ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://tempo.com/blog/introducing-mercator/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. **tempo.com has changed owners. The Meteored rules for it now break the site and should drop `tempo.com`.** tempo.com used to be Meteored's Italian weather site. Since Nov 17, 2026 it is the website of Tempo, a payments company, and has no Meteored code. The Meteored rules still apply to it, and one of them breaks the layout. **Breaking rule** (AdGuard Cookie Notices filter): ``` yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$#body { position: absolute !important; } ``` This rule shrinks `` to its content width (1320px in a 1989px window). The fixed header stays centred on the full window, the article is centred on only the left part, and the area to the right of the body is never painted, so it shows as a black block. Turning the blocker off fixes it. Safari, which doesn't have the rule, shows the page correctly. Applying the rule in plain Chromium reproduces the same broken layout. Browser: Helium (Chromium-based) on macOS, with its built-in ad blocker and the AdGuard lists above. **Please remove `tempo.com` from these rules.** They all target Meteored markup. The other domains stay as they are. | File | Line | Rule | |---|---|---| | AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt | [10892](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L10892) | `yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$##gpdr { display: none !important; }` | | AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt | [10893](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L10893) | `yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$#body { position: absolute !important; }` (breaks layout) | | AnnoyancesFilter/MobileApp/sections/mobile-app_specific.txt | [1590](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/AnnoyancesFilter/MobileApp/sections/mobile-app_specific.txt#L1590) | `yourweather.co.uk,theweather.net,tempo.pt,tempo.com,tiempo.com,meteored.*##.descarga-app` | | AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt | [5311](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt#L5311) | `tiempo.com,meteored.*,theweather.net,yourweather.co.uk,tempo.pt,tempo.com##.modulo-suscripcion` | | MobileFilter/sections/specific_web.txt | [1712](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/MobileFilter/sections/specific_web.txt#L1712) | `yourweather.co.uk,theweather.net,tempo.pt,tempo.com,tiempo.com,meteored.*#$#.pie-pagina { margin-bottom: 0 !important; }` | | SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt | [6294](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L6294) | `yourweather.co.uk,theweather.net,meteored.*,tempo.com,tempo.pt,tameteo.com###meteored_share` | | SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt | [11315](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L11315) | `…,theweather.net,tempo.com,tempo.pt,meteored.*,…##.shared` | | SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt | [13185](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L13185) | `tempo.com,tiempo.com##.botonera > span.boton:has(> span.shared)` | | SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt | [1943](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1943) | `tempo.pt,tempo.com,tiempo.com,meteored.*##.tappx-ad` | | SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt | [1944](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1944) | `tempo.pt,tempo.com,tiempo.com,meteored.*##.meteored-ads` | Only the `body` rule visibly breaks the site today. The others hide generic class names such as `.shared`, which could hide parts of the new site later. We've already guarded against this on our side with a CSS fix which keeps the page full width even when that rule applies. The report is so AdGuard removes the rules for everyone. 2. Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Reproduced the reporter's large red donation pop-up on theconversation.com/us:⁠ it is a native modal <⁠dialog⁠> that opens on load, dims the page and blocks clicks and wheel scrolling until its own close button is used. The fix is a trusted-click-element scriptlet that dismisses that dialog (plain CSS hiding leaves the native modal open and the page inert), but apply_rule never returned "verified" — the vision review rejected it once for pre-existing unloaded lazy images and once for the separate in-flow donation banner — so it goes to a maintainer unverified.

## Candidate for review

`theconversation.com#%#//scriptlet('trusted-click-element', 'dialog > section > button[aria-label="button.close"]')`

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version Helium built-in ad blocker ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? other (specify in comment below) ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://tempo.com/blog/introducing-mercator/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. **tempo.com has changed owners. The Meteored rules for it now break the site and should drop `tempo.com`.** tempo.com used to be Meteored's Italian weather site. Since Nov 17, 2026 it is the website of Tempo, a payments company, and has no Meteored code. The Meteored rules still apply to it, and one of them breaks the layout. **Breaking rule** (AdGuard Cookie Notices filter): ``` yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$#body { position: absolute !important; } ``` This rule shrinks `` to its content width (1320px in a 1989px window). The fixed header stays centred on the full window, the article is centred on only the left part, and the area to the right of the body is never painted, so it shows as a black block. Turning the blocker off fixes it. Safari, which doesn't have the rule, shows the page correctly. Applying the rule in plain Chromium reproduces the same broken layout. Browser: Helium (Chromium-based) on macOS, with its built-in ad blocker and the AdGuard lists above. **Please remove `tempo.com` from these rules.** They all target Meteored markup. The other domains stay as they are. | File | Line | Rule | |---|---|---| | AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt | [10892](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L10892) | `yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$##gpdr { display: none !important; ### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [NSFW] [https://hanime.tv/videos/hentai/shounen-ga-otona-ni-natta-natsu-4](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fhanime.tv%2Fvideos%2Fhentai%2Fshounen-ga-otona-ni-natta-natsu-4) ### Comment > Problem: AdGuard Advanced Protection breaks video playback despite website allowlisting and denied extension permissions > > Problem description > > I am experiencing an issue with the AdGuard Safari extension on iOS where embedded video players on hanime.tv become unresponsive when Advanced Protection is enabled. > > The video thumbnail and play button load normally, but tapping the play button does nothing. Long-pressing the play button brings up Safari’s image context menu, including the option to save the image to Photos. > > I have isolated the issue to the main AdGuard Safari extension responsible for Advanced Protection. All six standard AdGuard Safari content blockers can remain enabled without affecting video playback. > > Steps to reproduce > > 1. Enable all AdGuard Safari extensions, including the main AdGuard extension. > 2. Set the main extension’s website permissions to automatically allow access to other websites. > 3. Add hanime.tv to AdGuard’s Safari allowlist. > 4. Explicitly deny the AdGuard extension access to hanime.tv through Safari’s website-specific extension permissions. > 5. Open the website and attempt to play a video. > > Actual behavior > > The video player remains unresponsive despite the website being allowlisted and the extension being explicitly denied access to the domain. > > Interestingly, if I change the global website permission setting to Ask and manually deny access to the affected website, video playback works normally. > > However, as soon as I change the global permission setting to Always Allow for other websites, video playback stops working again, even though the affected website’s individual permission remains set to Deny. > > Expected behavior > > AdGuard should respect website-specific extension permissions and its internal Safari allowlist regardless of the global website permission setting. > > Advanced Protection should remain enabled on all other websites while being excluded from the affected website without requiring me to manually approve every new website I visit. > > Troubleshooting already performed > > * Disabled the main AdGuard Safari extension while keeping all six standard content blockers enabled — video playback works. > * Set global extension permissions to Ask and manually denied access to the affected website — video playback works. > * Set global extension permissions to Always Allow while denying access to the affected website — video playback fails. > * Added the affected domain to AdGuard’s Safari allowlist — issue persists. > * Tested a custom $jsinject exception — issue persists. > * Added custom $document and $elemhide exception rules. > * Reset Safari extension permissions — issue persists. > * Tested video playback in Aloha Browser — video playback works normally. > > Current configuration > > * Operating system: iOS 27.2.1 > * Browser: Safari > * DNS implementation: AdGuard > * DNS server: Cloudflare DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS) > * DNS filters: > * HaGeZi Multi PRO mini > * HaGeZi Threat Intelligence Feeds mini > * Divested Fingerprinting Blocklist > * Safari content blockers: All six enabled > * Advanced Protection: Enabled > > Additional information > > The issue appears to be isolated to the main AdGuard Safari extension rather than DNS protection or the standard Safari content blockers. > > Could this be an issue with Advanced Protection not respecting website-specific permissions, an interaction with cross-origin video frames, or a Safari extension permission bug? > > I would appreciate assistance identifying the underlying cause and finding a permanent solution that allows Advanced Protection to remain enabled globally while respecting individual website exclusions. ### [NSFW] Screenshots [Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/mqlfnfglqdcwoscsw4wcsw8kowc80c46k5kwu83dwc.png?nc=1) [Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/o8zisnj76f4w8o8w0448co4sosksckscphgbr11pu8.png?nc=1) ### System configuration | Information | Value | |-------------|-------| AdGuard product: | AdGuard for iOS v1.0 System version: | `IOS 27` License type: | paid Advanced protection: | enabled Filters: | **Ad blocking:**

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version Helium built-in ad blocker ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? other (specify in comment below) ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://tempo.com/blog/introducing-mercator/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. **tempo.com has changed owners. The Meteored rules for it now break the site and should drop `tempo.com`.** tempo.com used to be Meteored's Italian weather site. Since Nov 17, 2026 it is the website of Tempo, a payments company, and has no Meteored code. The Meteored rules still apply to it, and one of them breaks the layout. **Breaking rule** (AdGuard Cookie Notices filter): ``` yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$#body { position: absolute !important; } ``` This rule shrinks `` to its content width (1320px in a 1989px window). The fixed header stays centred on the full window, the article is centred on only the left part, and the area to the right of the body is never painted, so it shows as a black block. Turning the blocker off fixes it. Safari, which doesn't have the rule, shows the page correctly. Applying the rule in plain Chromium reproduces the same broken layout. Browser: Helium (Chromium-based) on macOS, with its built-in ad blocker and the AdGuard lists above. **Please remove `tempo.com` from these rules.** They all target Meteored markup. The other domains stay as they are. | File | Line | Rule | |---|---|---| | AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt | [10892](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L10892) | `yourweather.co.uk,tempo.com,daswetter.com#$##gpdr { display: none !important; }` | | SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt | [6294](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L6294) | `yourweather.co.uk,theweather.net,meteored.*,tempo.com,tempo.pt,tameteo.com###meteored_share` | | SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt | [11315](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L11315) | `…,theweather.net,tempo.com,tempo.pt,meteored.*,…##.shared` | | SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt | [13185](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt#L13185) | `tempo.com,tiempo.com##.botonera > span.boton:has(> span.shared)` | | SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt | [1943](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1943) | `tempo.pt,tempo.com,tiempo.com,meteored.*##.tappx-ad` | | SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt | [1944](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/4812eff50c6ddf22a0a93b19014ac9d732ed18ca/SpanishFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1944) | `tempo.pt,tempo.com,tiempo.com,meteored.*##.meteored-ads` | Only the `body` rule visibly breaks the site today. ### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);

- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;

### What product do you use?

AdGuard Browser Extension

### AdGuard version

5.5.4.82

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Chrome

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://did.kr/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Tracking Protection filter, AdGuard URL Tracking filter

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

Filter unblocking search ads and self-promotion

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

did.kr provides a chat widget that businesses embed on their own websites. The Tracking Protection rule `||did.kr^$third-party` blocks the whole domain, so on those sites the chat widget cannot open.

Reproduced with AdGuard Browser Extension 5.5.4.82 (AdGuard Tracking Protection filter 2.1.16.18) on a site that embeds the widget: the chat shows an error and its requests to did.kr are blocked. Disabling AdGuard fixes it. We can share an example site privately if needed. Browser: Chrome 156, macOS.

All tracking from the widget now goes to separate hosts. The widget requests that remain on did.kr and cdn.did.kr only run the widget:

- Tracking: track.did.kr, analytics.did.kr
- Widget: did.kr, cdn.did.kr

Could `||did.kr^$third-party` be replaced with `||track.did.kr^$third-party` and `||analytics.did.kr^$third-party`? Visitors stay protected from tracking, and the widget keeps working.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

The AdGuard Cookie Notices filter's purpose covers cookie notifications; the reported card is a domain-specific cookie notice, so the fix belongs in AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt. No existing rule covered 4ppl.pl and the only shared rule hiding the same element would also hide legitimate page content on this site, so a new narrow domain rule is the appropriate fix. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/96d50f6731ed801898962a90832f5f96b1b88eba/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) Under the heading `! Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — laveracaffe.pl shows a full-viewport cookie-consent modal (shadow DOM under #⁠lavera-cookie-manager-root) that dims the page and locks body scroll; it is built by the first-party script /wp-content/plugins/lavera-cookie-manager/assets/js/cookie-manager.js and no current filter covers it. The network rule blocking that loader removed the modal and the lock in validation, but the experiment stayed inconclusive on page integrity, so the rule is handed to a maintainer for AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt instead of being proposed as verified.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — AdGuard's generic `###cookies-modal` rule (cookies_general.txt:⁠829) hid shop.latexfauna.com's consent dialog while the site's consent backdrop and inline body{overflow:⁠hidden} lock stayed, freezing the storefront so nothing below the first screen could be reached. The domain-scoped exception `shop.latexfauna.com#@##cookies-modal` for AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_allowlist.txt restores the dialog and consent mechanism (apply_rule verified:⁠ hidden in phase B, visible in phase C, page integrity intact, no ads brought back); maintainers usually prefix the line with `! https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/248097`. ## Rule `shop.latexfauna.com#@##cookies-modal` ## Policy rationale The run instruction's Filter policy closes no such report:⁠ this is neither a paywall nor an anti-adblock wall, and the live capture shows the site's consent mechanism being suppressed with a measurable functional break (page cannot scroll, consent control unclickable). The repository's guidance for consent overlays applies:⁠ the gated function is broken because filtering suppressed the consent mechanism, so the fix restores that mechanism for the reported domain instead of hiding it further. <!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"1de3c1be521d035727f9f61f6c6896916cbdf0de162afad3eb3c9bd004841491"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported "spam on every click" was not reproducible:⁠ dasfootball.com's only ad loader is a page-injected Profiton popunder script (https:⁠//chinar.roamersitemise.com/rxLodV2fZ0Enfu3x/159586, id="profiton-pops"), already blocked on every load by an existing AdGuard Base filter regex rule, and six click rehearsals on the homepage and a match page opened no popup or tab; full-page vision found no ad instance or placeholder. No new rule is needed.

## Policy rationale

No repository policy rule closes this report:⁠ a popunder ad served by a third party is an ad that the instruction says gets a rule like any other ad ('Ads for other companies get a rule like any other ad'), so rule generation is allowed. The close recommendation rests only on live evidence that the reported spam window could not be reproduced, because the popunder loader it needs is already blocked by an existing AdGuard Base filter rule.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45565078634

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"bb2116de81ff2f2eb4e52cf8c7979ad31c9653ba9764d103cbd77cd3d0d1bfb2"} -->
The filter policy leaves this report to a maintainer

## Reproduced symptom

Variety's "Disable Your Adblocker" wall does reproduce on the reported URL under the reporter's filter selection, but it is an Admiral "Failsafe" overlay injected by an inline page-head script, and one click on its "Continue without disabling" button removes it and unlocks the fully loaded homepage without disabling the blocker. No captured request proves a detector script to target, and AdGuard's filter policy excludes ad-blocker messages that let the user proceed to the content, so I recommend closing without a rule and handing the anti-adblock report to a maintainer.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ "We do not block ad blocker detection messages that satisfy at least one of the following criteria:⁠ ... They provide an alternative to disabling an ad blocker given that this alternative does not put the users' privacy or security at risk ... They allow the user to proceed to the website's content" — the reported Variety overlay is exactly such a message:⁠ one click on its "Continue without disabling" button removed it and the full homepage content became visible, with no consent, payment, permission or reload required. Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ "Anti-adblock walls:⁠ write a rule only once the page's requests the agent captured show the detector script; without it, hand the report to a maintainer." The overlay is built by an inline script embedded in the served HTML (document.scripts[⁠20]⁠, sets window._afsr, renders an Admiral "Failsafe" template); no captured request demonstrates a detector script that a rule could target. The blocked third-party requests that plausibly belong to the same vendor (jsstore ge.js blocked by Tracking Protection, zodiacglass.com/files/.../enu.js) cannot be proven to drive this wall, so the report goes to a maintainer instead of a rule. Run instruction:⁠ the agent never closes an issue; this outcome recommends closing and a maintainer decides.

## Artifacts

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — geeksforgeeks.org loads a full-screen in-house promo modal (.saleModalPanel, fixed 1920x1080 with a rgba(0,0,0,0.4) dimming backdrop) that covers the homepage, matching the reporter's screenshot; the domain-scoped hide rule geeksforgeeks.org#⁠#⁠.saleModalPanel was verified in the AdGuard extension session (modal visible in phase B, hidden in phase C, page integrity intact, no residue). Rule belongs in AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt next to the site's existing self-promo rules. ## Rule `geeksforgeeks.org##.saleModalPanel` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale Run instruction:⁠ the site's own advertising (self-promotion) gets a rule proposed for AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt, with the maintainer deciding whether it is annoying enough. Not a paywall, not a consent/CMP gate, not an anti-adblock wall (no detector script was captured in the page requests), and not a scam/phishing page, so none of the instruction's close/hand-off rules applies. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f971ffa342b5a4b0e5e008c8fcbb9f30852e0396/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt) Under the heading `! SECTION: Self-promo - Regular rules`, before [line 3534](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f971ffa342b5a4b0e5e008c8fcbb9f30852e0396/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt#L3534). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45567505702 Automated analysis against filters at `f971ffa`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On the reported Business Insider article an inline self-promotion card ("Want more Business Insider in your news feed?" / "Add to Preferred Sources") appears in the article body after scrolling; it is baked into the page HTML, so a domain-scoped element-hiding rule removes it. businessinsider.com#⁠#⁠.preferred-sources-module was browser-verified in the reporter's profile (module hidden, page integrity intact, no residue), and it belongs in AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt before line 4337. ## Rule `businessinsider.com##.preferred-sources-module` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The run instruction's filter policy states that the site's own advertising, i.e. self-promotion of the site's own products and services with no third party paying, gets a rule proposed for AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt; the module promotes BI's own news-feed presence ('Add BI in Google'), so it is self-promotion, not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall and not a scam page. The run instruction states no rule that closes this report, so rule generation is open. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/e9d52afa63a9f342c2a94320628e86c433805345/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt) Under the heading `! SECTION: Self-promo - Regular rules`, before [line 4337](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/e9d52afa63a9f342c2a94320628e86c433805345/AnnoyancesFilter/Other/sections/self-promo.txt#L4337). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45565440613 Automated analysis against filters at `e9d52af`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — topgear.es shows a Marfeel/Didomi cookie-consent modal ("Acepta para leer gratis y sin límites", "Rechazar y pagar" / "Aceptar y cerrar") with a full-page dark backdrop that also locks `body` scrolling; the shared `##.mrf-cmp` rule leaves that backdrop, so the validated fix is the site-scoped CSS-injection rule `topgear.es#$#.mrf-cmp, #mrf-popup, body { overflow: visible !important; top: 100000px !important; }` in the Cookie Notices filter, which hides the overlay and releases the lock. Note `.mrf-cmp` is inert under these declarations and kept only as the Marfeel-CMP anchor shared with der-postillon.com/ghacks.net. ## Rule `topgear.es#$#.mrf-cmp, #mrf-popup, body { overflow: visible !important; top: 100000px !important; }` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The gate is a cookie-consent notice (Marfeel CMP backed by Didomi) over content that is already served and readable behind it — the dialog offers 'Acepta para leer gratis y sin límites' — so it is not a content paywall, which is the only annoyance case the instruction closes without a rule. It is not an anti-adblock wall:⁠ no detector script, no request to disable the ad blocker; the reporter's own text and the captured network inventory show a consent dialog only. The AdGuard Cookie Notices filter's documented purpose is to block cookie notices and consent-management-platform requests, so the fix belongs to rule generation in that filter. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/e9d52afa63a9f342c2a94320628e86c433805345/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) Under the heading `! NOTE: Regular rules`, before [line 407](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/e9d52afa63a9f342c2a94320628e86c433805345/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L407). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/45564433984 Automated analysis against filters at `e9d52af`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
